packageRules.description: fedora base image major bumps are IGNORED (not even proposed): the fedora:46/rawhide image's dnf repos serve fc45-built packages with a keyring mismatch, breaking container builds (same upstream defect as tuna-os/tacklebox#205, tuna-os/bluefin-cli#167). automerge:false alone did not stop renovate elsewhere -- tacklebox PRs #209/#211 auto-merged anyway -- so enabled:false is what prevents PR creation. e2e.yml's kde job and screenshots-kde.yml both run in quay.io/fedora/fedora:45. Carried over from frontends/kde/renovate.json, which Renovate never read: it reads only the repository root. Remove this rule once the upstream image is consistent.

tuna-os/* actions stay on @main in uses: lines, and .github/workflows/actions.lock holds the commit that runs. Do not add digests to them. tuna-os/* reusable workflows are pinned by hand to a full SHA with a # main comment; Renovate updates that SHA (docs/RELEASE.md, Action pinning).
Wait 7 days before taking a new action release (supply-chain cooldown).

fisherman: the submodule gitlink is the only pin; every Flatpak builds fisherman from the submodule (shared/flatpak/fisherman.json, TestFishermanPin). It tracks fisherman's prod branch, which only advances after fisherman's promote gate (its E2E matrix green plus a soak), so only released fisherman commits are pinned. Merge on green.

COSMIC wasm fork pins (frontends/cosmic/web/cargo-patch.toml, #105): never automerge. Only the advisory wasm-cosmic.yml job builds them, and it stays green when the check fails, so green proves nothing. Read the job's step summary before merging. shared/browser/wasm-patches/CARRIED.md says how to move them.

customManagers.description: COSMIC wasm fork pins on the master branch of tuna-os/libcosmic and tuna-os/rust-atomicwrites.

COSMIC wasm fork pin on the tuna-os/iced carry branch: patches 06 and 03 on the iced commit that the libcosmic pin has as its submodule. A new carry branch (a new libcosmic iced pin) needs this branch name changed by hand.
